# QuolyTech

> QuolyTech is a technology and design agency in Tiranë, Albania. It helps businesses grow with AI systems and agents, startup and SaaS development, web and mobile apps, UI/UX design, systems management and social media marketing, for clients in Albania and internationally.

## Services
- [AI Agent Development](https://quolytech.com/services/ai-agents/): AI agents that answer customers 24/7, qualify leads and automate repetitive tasks, connected to your website and CRM. Built by QuolyTech in Tiranë, Albania.
- [Startup Development & Launch](https://quolytech.com/services/startup-development/): Startup development for founders: MVP prototyping, technical architecture, launch strategy and marketing with one team. QuolyTech, Tiranë, Albania.
- [SaaS Platform Development](https://quolytech.com/services/saas-development/): SaaS platform development from scratch: cloud-based, secure Software as a Service products ready for the global market. QuolyTech, Tiranë, Albania.
- [Web Development](https://quolytech.com/services/web-development/): Custom websites and web applications for businesses, built with React, Next.js and WordPress. Fast, mobile-friendly and SEO-ready. QuolyTech, Tiranë, Albania.
- [Mobile App Development](https://quolytech.com/services/mobile-app-development/): iOS and Android app development for businesses and startups with React Native, from UX design to App Store and Google Play launch. QuolyTech, Albania.
- [UI/UX Design](https://quolytech.com/services/ui-ux-design/): UI/UX design for websites, web apps and mobile apps: wireframes, prototypes and interfaces that are attractive, intuitive and functional. QuolyTech, Albania.
- [Systems Management](https://quolytech.com/services/systems-management/): IT systems management: administration, optimization and maintenance of servers, hosting, databases and applications. QuolyTech, Tiranë, Albania.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://quolytech.com/services/social-media-marketing/): Social media marketing for businesses: strategy, content and digital campaigns that grow your online presence and engagement. QuolyTech, Tiranë, Albania.
- [Custom Software](https://quolytech.com/services/software-development/): Custom business software: admin portals, dashboards and internal tools built around your workflows and integrations. QuolyTech, Tiranë, Albania.
- [Business Automation](https://quolytech.com/services/business-automation/): Business process automation that connects your tools and removes manual work: lead routing, CRM sync, emails and documents. QuolyTech, Tiranë, Albania.
- [SEO & Digital Growth](https://quolytech.com/services/seo/): Technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, structured data and site architecture that help your business get found on Google. QuolyTech, Tiranë, Albania.
- [Branding & Digital Identity](https://quolytech.com/services/branding/): Brand identity design for businesses: logo, color palette, typography, brand guidelines and social media graphics. QuolyTech, Tiranë, Albania.

## Industries
- [Healthcare & Clinics](https://quolytech.com/industries/healthcare/): Websites and appointment request systems for clinics, dental practices and healthcare providers, built by QuolyTech in Tiranë, Albania.
- [E-Commerce & Retail](https://quolytech.com/industries/ecommerce/): Online store and e-commerce development for retailers: product catalogs, payment gateways, inventory sync and mobile shopping. QuolyTech, Albania.
- [Real Estate & Property](https://quolytech.com/industries/real-estate/): Property listing websites for real estate agencies and developers, with property search, inquiry forms and AI lead qualification. QuolyTech, Albania.
- [Hospitality & Tourism](https://quolytech.com/industries/hospitality/): Websites for hotels, restaurants and car rental companies with direct booking inquiries and 24/7 guest answers. QuolyTech, Tiranë, Albania.
- [Professional Services](https://quolytech.com/industries/professional-services/): Corporate websites, client portals and lead generation for law firms, accounting practices and consultancies. QuolyTech, Tiranë, Albania.
- [Automotive & Services](https://quolytech.com/industries/automotive/): Websites and lead management systems for car dealerships, service centers and rental companies. QuolyTech, Tiranë, Albania.

## Portfolio & Case Studies
- [Shqiponja Energy](https://quolytech.com/projects/shqiponja/): High-conversion digital flagship and e-commerce showcase for Shqiponja, an all-natural Albanian energy beverage featuring zero sugar, natural caffeine, and crisp mountain botanicals. (Live: https://shqiponja-rho.vercel.app/)
- [Valence Studio](https://quolytech.com/projects/valence/): Immersive editorial archive and interactive showcase for an international avant-garde spatial design studio operating across Berlin, Tokyo, and Paris. (Live: https://valence-khaki.vercel.app/)
- [Omega Architecture](https://quolytech.com/projects/omega-architecture/): Architectural configurator and digital reservation platform for eco-responsible passive residences engineered with self-weathering corten steel and net-zero bioclimatic envelopes. (Live: https://mono-store-eta.vercel.app/#reserve)
- [Paperfolio](https://quolytech.com/projects/paperfolio/): High-personality creative portfolio and interactive playground built with tactile card mechanics, neo-brutalist styling, vibrant micro-interactions, and bold typography. (Live: https://paperfolio-sigma.vercel.app/)
- [Meridian Analytics](https://quolytech.com/projects/meridian-analytics/): Institutional-grade financial analytics suite featuring real-time portfolio attribution, Monte Carlo stress testing, volatility surface mapping, and enterprise risk metrics. (Live: https://fin-analytics-three.vercel.app/)
- [Katachi Design](https://quolytech.com/projects/katachi/): Editorial e-commerce lookbook and spatial design showcase honoring Japanese minimalism and Belgian artisanal craftsmanship in furniture. (Live: https://katachi-flax-psi.vercel.app/)
- [Vendôme Joaillerie](https://quolytech.com/projects/vendome/): Ultra-luxury digital flagship for Place Vendôme Paris haute joaillerie, showcasing rare diamonds, bespoke high jewelry collections, and private salon appointments. (Live: https://vendome-ashen.vercel.app/)
- [Quolix AI](https://quolytech.com/projects/quolix/): High-velocity developer platform and deployment suite for building, testing, and shipping autonomous AI agents, LLM pipelines, and automated business workflows. (Live: https://quolix-woad.vercel.app/)
- [Skooly EduCloud](https://quolytech.com/projects/skooly-edu/): Comprehensive multi-role academic ERP and school management platform serving super administrators, teachers, parents, and students with centralized grading and attendance. (Live: https://azure-moose-466393.hostingersite.com/)
- [Pavlos Kolias](https://quolytech.com/projects/pavlos-kolias/): Scholarly digital portfolio and research directory for mathematician and statistician Pavlos Kolias, integrating Google Scholar indexing, publications, and university curriculum. (Live: https://pavloskolias.com/)
- [EduManage Enterprise](https://quolytech.com/projects/edumanage/): Enterprise-grade educational infrastructure portal providing real-time student progress tracking, multi-campus governance, tuition accounting, and parent engagement channels. (Live: https://azure-moose-466393.hostingersite.com/)
- [QuolyWheels](https://quolytech.com/projects/quolywheels/): Modern automotive portal featuring dual rental and purchase workflows, real-time fleet inventory, custom speedometer preloader, multi-language support, and test drive reservations. (Live: https://quolywheels.quolytech.com/)
- [Hypocrates Dental](https://quolytech.com/projects/hypocrates-dental/): State-of-the-art medical website for a leading dental clinic in Tiranë, Albania, showcasing oral surgery, titanium implants, 3D orthodontics, before/after transformations, and online appointment booking. (Live: https://hypocrates-dental-web-demo.netlify.app/)
- [FlowPilot Operations](https://quolytech.com/projects/flowpilot/): All-in-one SaaS powerhouse for field service operations, technician GPS dispatching, digital signature sign-offs, industrial asset maintenance logs, and automated Stripe invoicing. (Live: https://flowpilot-operations.netlify.app/)
